_doc: MISUMI's post-assembly insertion nut (HNTF5) for its 5 series, 6 mm slot, M3. MISUMI makes it in M3 and M4 only for this slot: there is no M5. Hold: MISUMI gives no figure.
name: slot-nut-6-misumi-m3-drop-in

slot.rule: Made for MISUMI's 5 series (slot width 6 mm)
slot.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-562, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

thread.rule: Thread M3, one of the sizes the table lists (M3, M4)
thread.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-562, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

nut_kind.rule: Put in through the opening and turned a quarter turn: a rhomboid with its corners cut at 15 degrees
nut_kind.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-562, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

length.rule: Along the slot once turned: 6 on the drawing, narrow enough to pass the opening lengthwise
length.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-562, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

width.rule: Across the slot once turned: 10 on the drawing, its corners cut at 15 degrees so it turns
width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-562, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

height.rule: The body under the lips: 3.3 on the drawing (T = 4.1 overall)
height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-562, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

tongue_width.rule: Width of the step that stands in the opening, dimensioned on the drawing
tongue_width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-562, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

tongue_height.rule: Height of that step: the drawing's overall height less the body's
tongue_height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-562, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

nut_entry.rule: Post-assembly insertion: put in through the opening anywhere along the slot
nut_entry.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-562, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

material.rule: Material as the table names it
material.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-562, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

hold.rule: Rexroth rates its T-nut in a 6 mm slot (M4) at 1700 N. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m3 thread set (ISO 898-1)
